66: **Unifying theme**: The BCS chain was proven unconditional (5/5 links PASS, S35), but the tau-stabilization problem remained. The Structural Monotonicity Theorem (S37) killed the entire spectral action category with a single proof: <lambda^2>(tau) increases monotonically, all sectors monotone in the same direction. The F.5 wrong-sign result revealed that the spectral action penalizes pairing (BdG eigenvalues are always larger than bare). The instanton gas was identified but CC-through-instanton was closed because the F.5 anti-trapping survives under instanton averaging.
